newsitem.title: BOLIVIA: Bolivia's YPFB sees $5 mln loss in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Bolivia's YPFB sees $5 mln loss in 1997.

text.p: Bolivia's Yacimientos Petroliferos Fiscales Bolivianos (YPFB) will show a $5 million loss this year, the oil company's president said Friday.
YPFB's oil and gas production arms were privatized late last year, and the state now only carries out some administrative and service functions at the company.
"Due to the process of (privatization), the company is in a very precarious economic position," said YPFB President Carlos Salinas Estenssoro.
He said YPFB had to aggressively seek business in the oil services sector.
